name: Hazuki Shizuku
source:
A member of the idol group "Mistica". She's popular for being a cool beauty, as well as a good singer. 

To keep her cool beauty image, she wrote in her profile that she doesn't like sweets, but in reality, she has quite the sweet tooth, and is a frequent visitor of "Oukadou", a Japanese confectionery. 

Her late grandfather was a painter. He was not famous, but has many zealous fans around the world. Because he didn't paint much, his works fetch an unusually high price. 

Even so, she wants to collect all of her grandfather's paintings. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/yobai4/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
